related_questions.question: What are the side effects of the 5th COVID booster?
related_questions.snippet: Common side effects include pain at the injection site, fever, body aches and headaches. These reactions are frequent (and indicate that your body is making an immune response to the vaccine) and should go away within 1-2 days, with the exception that swollen lymph nodes may persist up to about 10 days.
related_questions.title: Tips to reduce side effects after getting the COVID-19 vaccine

related_questions.question: How much does a COVID vaccine cost without insurance?
related_questions.snippet: The vaccine is no longer free for most people without insurance. If you don't have health coverage and don't use discounts, you can expect to pay $200 or more for a COVID vaccine. And an administration fee may be added to the cost of your shot. You may be able to save on your COVID vaccine with a GoodRx coupon.
related_questions.title: How Much Does a COVID Vaccine Cost? - GoodRx

related_questions.question: When can I have a booster for COVID?
related_questions.snippet: The vaccine should usually be offered no earlier than around 6 months after the last vaccine dose. If you are eligible, you can get protection from an autumn COVID-19 vaccination even if you have not taken up a COVID-19 vaccine offer in the past.
